WORKSPACE GUIDE

A few things to know

Build & inspect

Create a machine by specifying states, symbols, a start state, accepting states, and a complete transition table. Click graph states or use the transition inspector. The arrow marks the start state; a double circle marks acceptance.

Trace & compare

Run a string, then play or step through its path. Enter a string to trace its path. Batch testing accepts one string per line and ignores blank lines. Union uses two DFAs with the same alphabet.

Save your work

Machines are saved in this browser automatically. Export JSON for a portable backup; local browser data can be cleared. You can also export the diagram as SVG.

An ongoing model

DFA functionality is available now. NFA and GNFA support is planned. The public interface preserves the original model and adds integration code separately.

Workspace limits: 144 states per machine, 12 symbols, 20 saved machines, and 256 symbols per test. String tools use up to 24 basic Unicode characters; emoji are supported in DFA simulation, but not the original string suffix utility.
